pr_title: Add a HitObjectUsageEventBuffer to handle HOC events appropriately
pr_body:
Closes #11453

Prereqs:
- [x] https://github.com/ppy/osu/pull/12782

The `HitObjectUsageBegan` and `HitObjectUsageFinished` events from multiple `HitObjectContainer`s need to be combined and handled appropriately to handle cases where hitobjects are moved between `HitObjectContainer`s.

This introduces a new event as part of the buffer: `HitObjectUsageTransferred`. This event notifies that the hitobject is still alive but its DHO may have changed - it could be the same DHO or another.
The composer responds to this event and updates the (also still alive) blueprint to point to the new DHO.

issue_context.title: Selection is lost when a HitObject is moved to another playfield when using pooling
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug:** 
When handling a movement within the selection handler, if the resulting position leads to the HitObject changing playfields, the HitObject is deselected, requiring users to reselect and repeat to move further.

Problem encountered in the sentakki ruleset, the lane in LanedHitObject is handled similarly to columns in ManiaHitObject.
<https://github.com/LumpBloom7/sentakki/blob/Editor/osu.Game.Rulesets.Sentakki/Edit/SentakkiSelectionHandler.cs#L26-L50>

A half-workaround that I did manage to find is to remove the HO from `EditorBeatmap.SelectedHitObjects`, then readding it after the lane has been changed. This ensures the SelectionBlueprint is shown, but still won't continue responding to the current drag event.

**Screenshots or videos showing encountered issue:** 

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/12001167/104127617-6ec1e280-5363-11eb-918e-839d1641fcac.mp4

**osu!lazer version:** 
2021.109.0

**Logs:**
N/A
comments: I guess we haven't encountered this yet because mania doesn't use pooling. I think this will likely be addressed along with the mania pooling implementation in the coming month or two.

review_comments: Not blocking this PR but I wonder `Playfield` should provide `HitObject` -> `DrawableHitObject` mapping public.
I agree. This line in particular can probably benefit from optimisation as it's `O(n^2)`, but that also requires HOC changes + #12627.
